movie.title: Samakdo
movie.overview: The producer of the accusation program begins to track the cult 'Samsundo' and the historical facts behind it. The more they try to find out about 'Samsundo', the more they become engulfed in a bizarre phenomenon. Will they be able to safely arrive at 'Thousand Years' Shrine, the only shrine in Korea, and let the whole story known to the world?

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An investigative TV producer tracking a dangerous cult becomes entangled in terrifying paranormal phenomena as they race to expose the group's dark historical secrets.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A determined accusation program producer launches an investigation into 'Samsundo,' a mysterious local cult with deep historical roots. As the inquiry deepens, the production team is targeted by increasingly horrific and unexplainable paranormal occurrences that threaten their sanity and lives. Their ultimate goal is to reach the sacred 'Thousand Years' Shrine—Korea's sole surviving ancient sanctuary—where the cult's ultimate truth lies hidden. Time is running out as the line between reality and supernatural terror vanishes, forcing the team to risk everything to bring the story to light.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Driven by a desire to reveal hidden truths, a dedicated television producer begins probing into the origins and illegal activities of a cryptic religious sect known as 'Samsundo.' Initial routine investigative work quickly takes a dark turn as the crew uncovers historical documentation connecting the cult to centuries of suppressed regional tragedies. As they probe deeper into the cult's hierarchy, the producer and crew members suffer terrifying psychological torment and bizarre supernatural events that defy rational explanation. Reality begins to warp around the team, isolating them from outside help as unseen forces try to halt their broadcast. Clues point toward the legendary 'Thousand Years' Shrine, the only historic sanctuary of its kind in Korea, as the geographical focal point of the cult's dark power. Journeying toward this remote and dangerous location, the producer must navigate both human hostility from fanatic cult members and escalating horrific phenomena. Reaching the shrine becomes a desperate struggle for survival, as it holds the key to dismantling Samsundo's influence. Ultimately, the producer must overcome immense psychological dread and physical peril to expose the complete, terrifying story to the world before becoming another victim of the ancient evil.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: When a investigative broadcast producer targets 'Samsundo'—an enigmatic and insular cult wrapped in historical mystery—what starts as a routine exposé quickly spirals into a fight for survival. The deeper the investigation goes into the cult's background, the more the production team is haunted by surreal and horrifying phenomena. To uncover the truth and survive the ordeal, the producer must reach the 'Thousand Years' Shrine, Korea's only sacred sanctuary of its kind, and broadcast the cult's secrets to the world.

faq.answer: The story follows the producer of an investigative television program who tracks down the origins and secrets of an obscure, fanatical cult called 'Samsundo'. As the investigation progresses, the team becomes trapped in eerie, inexplicable supernatural phenomena in an isolated village.
faq.question: What is the main plot of Samakdo?

faq.answer: Samsundo is a fictional apocalyptic cult in the film, inspired by historical Korean cults from the Japanese colonial era, that retreated into secrecy and performed dark rituals to appease a sinister deity.
faq.question: What is 'Samsundo' in the film?

faq.answer: The main cast features Jo Yoon-seo as TV producer Chae So-yeon, Kwak Si-yang as Japanese journalist Matsuda, and Im So-young as junior producer Woo A-ram.
faq.question: Who are the lead actors starring in Samakdo?

faq.answer: The 'Thousand Years' Shrine serves as the central focal point and climax destination of the mystery, harboring the ultimate secrets and dangerous truths behind the Samsundo cult.
faq.question: What role does the 'Thousand Years Shrine' play in the story?

faq.answer: While the plot and characters are fictional horror storytelling, the narrative draws loose inspiration from real-world historical cult movements and religious fanaticism in Korea during the Japanese colonial period.
faq.question: Is Samakdo based on a true story?

faq.answer: Viewer discretion is advised as the film features intense psychological suspense, disturbing cult ritualistic imagery, and classic occult horror elements.
faq.question: Is Samakdo suitable for viewers sensitive to psychological horror or gore?

faq.answer: The original dialogue is in Korean (with some Japanese), but it is made available to international audiences with English subtitles.
